name: Malliß (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Malliß (crossed white hammers on red above a green oak leaf on white).
history: Municipal flag of Malliß; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Malliß arms — hammers and oak leaf
